protocol.name: pilot_zoom_kvasir_v1
protocol.purpose: Evaluation-only pilot of scale-canonical two-pass inference ("locate, then zoom"). No training. Uses only Kvasir Val images, synthetically rescaled. No Test or OOD image is read.
protocol.motivation_disclosure: The size-prior weakness was quantified on Test/OOD predictions of the accepted models (reports/test_detail_mix_20261004). The method parameters below are therefore developed only on source Val data; any Test confirmation needs a separate locked suite.
protocol.prompt: a polyp in a colonoscopy image
protocol.condition_definition: scale < 1: image shrunk (area interpolation) and pasted at the centre of a black canvas of the original size. scale > 1: window of 1/scale of each side cropped around the lesion bounding-box centre. scale = 1: the original Val files.

zoom.fusion: second-pass map replaces the first inside the window; zero outside; first pass kept if the second is empty

protocol.oracle_note: Oracle configs take the window from the ground truth. Diagnostic upper bound only; never a method.
protocol.selection: Among the four non-oracle configs, the highest three-seed mean DSC averaged with equal weight over the five conditions; ties go to the first listed.

gate.description: Fixed before any number of this pilot was computed. Applied to the selected config versus single-pass.
gate.pass_rule: p0 and g1 and g2 and g3
gate.if_p0_fails: verdict is proxy_invalid (the synthetic shift does not reproduce the weakness); no conclusion about the method

disclosures: Selection and gate use the same development data; the gate is optimistic and is not a Test result.
Black-canvas shrinking is a proxy for small lesions, not real small-lesion data.
